summary: Deprecates the NAT-MIB module defined in RFC 4008 because of deficiencies found in it. All its objects are kept unchanged except that their status becomes deprecated. A companion document defines a replacement, NATV2-MIB, and this document obsoletes RFC 4008.

eli5.summary: An old form is marked 'do not use anymore' but is not thrown away, because a better form has been made.
